@Lisa — thanks for the quick review. Short answers below and next steps:

1) SOC2 scope: the SOC2 Type II report covers the hosted Redwood API and Dedicated environments that are run by Redwood in our cloud regions. Private (customer-managed VPC/on-prem) deployments are not covered by the SOC2 attestation by default; we document the shared-responsibility model in the evidence bundle and we can provide a letter describing the controls customers must operate in private deployments.

2) Pen test letter: the attached PenTest_Letter_Q4_2025.pdf is a summary letter from our third-party assessor covering network perimeter and application-layer testing, plus remediation confirmation for high/critical issues. Full technical reports are available under NDA; let us know if you want the assessor contact and we’ll coordinate.

3) DPA: the DocuSign link will route to Acme legal for signature; because you mentioned redlines, I’ve also attached the tracked-change Word doc (DPA_Redline_KP_20260325.docx). If you prefer exchanged redlines we can accept those into our legal process.

Next steps I’ll take: send the DocuSign envelope to your legal contact once you confirm the signer, and cc Sergio for marketplace artifact submission to AWS. Karthik will confirm the SKU and listing metadata for the marketplace submission.

Forwarded evidence: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/evidence/DL-2026-ACME-45/

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
